title: bank of canada / monetary policy report / rate cut | Monetary Policy Report | Monetary Policy Report—January 2025
summary: The Bank of Canada reduced its target overnight rate by 25 basis points to 3% and announced the end of quantitative tightening, with the Bank Rate at 3.25% and deposit rate at 2.95%. Inflation has been around 2% since August 2024, and the Canadian economy is in modest excess supply with growth forecast to average 1.8% in 2025 and 2026. US tariff threats represent a major source of uncertainty affecting business confidence, investment intentions, and contributing to Canadian dollar depreciation.
